title: The IRS Secretly Owns 22% of Your 401k
hook: You've been watching that 401k balance grow for years — but the IRS is the silent co-owner of every dollar in it, and nobody told you to plan for that.
angle: Pre-tax retirement savers count their gross balance as net worth, not realizing a massive deferred tax liability is hidden inside — and required minimum distributions at 73 can force withdrawals that push them into higher brackets
audience: Workers 35-60 with significant traditional 401k balances who have never thought about the tax bill waiting at withdrawal
key_numbers: 22% = average effective tax rate at retirement for median earner
$66,000 of a $300K 401k already belongs to the IRS
Age 73: RMDs force mandatory withdrawals whether you need the money or not
Roth conversion window: ages 60-72, before RMDs take control
401k millionaires can owe $220K-$370K in deferred taxes
